How we work

Our digital marketing process

A clear, collaborative process that turns ambitious ideas into measurable business growth.

01

Research of the Dubai Advertising Market

Before we start any campaign, we do our homework on the Dubai market. We check which platforms people actually use and which trends are picking up. We were also one of the first agencies to try TikTok for our clients’ ads. Over time, we’ve learned how locals and visitors in the UAE browse and shop online, and we use that to make ads that fit your audience.

02

Clear Goals and Numbers You Can Track

We don’t like guessing, so every project starts with a simple talk about what you want. More website visitors, more leads, or more online sales, we note it down. Then we pick a number for each goal and keep an eye on it all the way through. After 10+ years in digital marketing, we know what a good result looks like, and we show it to you in real figures, not vague promises.

03

A Content Plan Made Just for You

Good content does two jobs: it promotes your business and shapes how people see your brand. We write for real people, so the tone feels close and friendly without ever losing respect for local traditions. Your content should do more than share useful information. It should feel like a trusted friend who happens to know your business well.

04

Getting You Found on Google with SEO and SEM

Search results are crowded, and we want your business to stand out in them. We fix your website content around the words people really type into Google, so you get free leads without paying for every click. On top of that, we run Google Ads to bring in buyers through quality PPC campaigns. That way you get visitors from both organic search and paid ads.

05

Social Media That Gets People Talking

Your customers are already on social media, chatting, asking questions, and deciding which brands to trust. We keep your brand active on the platforms that are popular in Dubai right now. We post with a clear message and a proper plan behind it, so people don’t just follow you, they start to feel part of your brand’s community.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about working with Sham Marianas.

01What services does Sham Marianas FZC offer?+

We provide B2B digital marketing, IT solutions, brand building, paid advertising, SEO, social media, content, and lead-generation strategies.

02How can digital marketing help my business grow?+

Our strategy connects your brand with the right audience, builds trust, and turns qualified attention into measurable enquiries and sales.

03Do you work with B2B businesses in Dubai and the UAE?+

Yes. We understand the Dubai and UAE market and tailor campaigns for local, regional, and international B2B growth.

04How long does it take to see results?+

Timelines depend on your goals and channel mix. We establish quick wins first while building sustainable results over the following months.

05Can you build a strategy around my budget and goals?+

Absolutely. We start with your objectives, audience, and budget, then recommend a focused plan that can scale with your business.

06Do you provide reporting and performance tracking?+

Yes. You receive clear performance updates, useful insights, and recommendations tied to the outcomes that matter to your business.

07How do we get started?+

Send us a message through the contact page and we will arrange a focused conversation about your business and next steps.
